figurative_meaning_en: A fight in which both parties are destroyed
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীর মধ্যে শুম্ভ-নিশুম্ভের লড়াই চলছে, কেউই জিততে পারবে না।
ব্যবসায়িক প্রতিযোগিতা শুম্ভ-নিশুম্ভের লড়াইয়ের মতো হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The two rivals are engaged in a Shumbha-Nishumbha battle, where neither will emerge victorious.
The business competition has turned into a fight like that of Shumbha and Nishumbha, leading to mutual ruin.
history: This idiom originates from Hindu mythology in the Devi Mahatmya, where Shumbha and Nishumbha, two powerful demon brothers, wage war against Goddess Durga and are ultimately destroyed along with their armies.
note: Rooted in the epic battle symbolizing the triumph of good over evil, but used figuratively for self-destructive conflicts.
